title: Mild mapo tofu
summary: Mild mapo tofu is a chinese dinner built around firm tofu and turkey breast mince, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Mild mapo tofu. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add firm tofu and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and turkey breast mince.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until pak choi is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Mild mapo tofu before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Mild mapo tofu.
